Hire (tenderloin) katsu would likely be a safer bet. ``` ## Review I visited this place to have dinner near Seoul Station. There weren't as many places to eat around Seoul Station as I expected, so it took some effort to find one. Because the weather was hot and humid, we looked for a place where we could eat indoors without going too far outside, which narrowed our options even further. Still, we found a `tonkatsu` place that looked like the most solid and reliable choice. Located in the Seoul Station food court, it was popular enough to have a waiting line. ```adcard ``` Fortunately, there was only one party ahead of us, so right after registering on the waitlist, we were able to enter without much delay. The ordering system involved scanning a QR code on the table, and paying at the counter upon leaving. After much deliberation, we ordered the Curry Katsu Set and the Rosu Katsu Set. ```adcard ``` The food was served quickly after ordering. Perhaps because I usually like curry, I enjoyed the Curry Katsu very much. I did feel a slight pity that there wasn't a bit more curry so I could eat it with the rice as well. There was an option to add extra curry on the menu, which in hindsight would have been great to order. The `Rosu Katsu` had some fatty parts since it is pork loin, so it was slightly greasy. If you can't eat greasy food well, `Hire Katsu` would probably be better. Overall, it was a relatively solid and enjoyable meal. ## Pictures
